sv.title: Aktieprofilen köper i frossan: ”Botten är satt”
sv.summary: Efter 26 år på Stockholmsbörsen har den tidigare mäklarchefen Oskar Ekman gjort debut på USA-börsen mitt i AI-turbulensen. I Di:s podd Fear & Greed spår han att börsen har bottnat, ger småspararna rätt i Nvidia – och avslöjar vilka svenska aktier han köper nu.

en.title: Stock profile buys into the frenzy: "The bottom is in"
en.summary: After 26 years on the Stockholm Stock Exchange, former brokerage chief Oskar Ekman has made his debut on the US exchange in the middle of the AI turbulence. In Di's podcast Fear & Greed he predicts that the market has bottomed out, says small savers were right about Nvidia – and reveals which Swedish shares he is buying now.
